messages:
Sam: Quick design check — table column resizer is causing layout jank at narrow widths (320px). The visible line is fine but the hit area overlaps the row action buttons. Screenshot in thread.
Olivia: Ugh yeah I noticed that in the dashboard compact view. Feels fiddly to grab. Do we want a larger invisible hit area or move the handle edge inward?
Mike: I can increase the hit area in CSS, but if we make it too wide it’ll look like extra gutter. I usually do 12-16px hit area with a 2px visible line. Example:
```
.table__resizer { width: 16px; margin-left: -8px; }
.table__resizer::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; width: 2px; background: var(--muted-600); transform: translateX(-50%); }
```
Olivia: That approach works — visible affordance stays thin but interaction becomes easier.
Jordan: Accessibility note: ensure the resizer is keyboard operable and exposed to screen readers. Use role="separator" + tabindex="0" and aria-orientation="horizontal". Also announce size changes with live region.
Mike: Yep can add keyboard drag with arrow keys and make changes incremental. I’ll add a small announcer: `aria-live="polite"` updates on resize.
Sam: One more thought — spacing tokens. The resizer hit area uses a hard pixel value. We should use tokens so themes and scale adjust. I proposed `spacing.resizer` in the token list but it collides with existing tiny/spaces naming.
Olivia: We try to avoid one-off tokens. Maybe map to existing tokens like `spacing-08` or `space-xs`, but add an alias `resizer-hit` so designers can find it.
DesignBot: Heads-up — there is an existing token `spacing-08` used across table rows. Renaming tokens is a breaking change; please open a token-deprecation plan if you'd like to add aliases.
Sam: Good call. Proposal: add alias `resizer-hit` -> `spacing-08` and document it in tokens.md. Keep visible line at `border-width-1` and use `resizer-hit` for hit-area.
Mike: I’ll PR: update CSS, add alias, and include keyboard handlers. I'll put a canary in staging to validate mobile touch and narrow widths.
Jordan: For a11y testing, I'll run VoiceOver + NVDA checks and a keyboard-only walkthrough. If we can get no regressions, thumbs up.
Olivia: Also small copy tweak for the tooltip: change from "Drag to resize" to "Drag or use ← → to resize" so keyboard users see the hint.
Sam: Nice — short checklist: 1) Mike PR for CSS + JS, 2) add token alias + docs, 3) Jordan a11y pass, 4) Olivia copy tweak. Assign owners?
Mike: Taking 1 & 2.
Jordan: Taking 3.
Olivia: I’ll update tooltip copy and mock screenshots.
Sam: Great — thanks all. Can someone drop the staging link here when ready? :thumbsup:
Mike: Will do, ETA EOD.
DesignBot: New PR created for token alias — #3421. CI: tests passing.
Sam: Perfect, I’ll review the PR tomorrow morning. Thanks! :rocket:
